caption: Four independent molecular-label assemblies across two wells agree at 523 bp. Q20-trimmed evidence supports 494 bases, of which 393 have both directions. Grey terminals lack accepted Q20 support and use recorded primers. C280 is the unique linker stop-gain candidate.
Raw processed ABI traces at aligned candidate C280 in no-editor and 1:8 samples. F uses C/T and R uses G/A. Signal amplitudes remain direction-specific; no editing percentage is inferred.

The flagged 1-8-2.F trace has only 60% matching flanking positions at the putative target. Its site statistic is excluded by the declared flank-identity screen, while its original trace and reverse read remain available.

Twelve wells, n=2 per dose. Directional summaries retain eligible reads; the combined index uses only complete F/R molecular-label pairs. The index is not an edited-RNA fraction. One high-dose well has only one complete pair.
Twenty-three complete technical F/R pairs are grouped within 12 independent wells. Direction bias grows with signal; correlation alone does not establish quantitative agreement.

All covered cytidines are screened descriptively. Other dose-associated secondary peaks exist; these are candidate bystander/technical signatures, not validated edits or multiplicity-controlled discoveries. C280 was selected by linker/codon evidence, not this ranking.

Twenty independent S7 transfection wells, two per mass fraction. Three prespecified low-complexity fits; shaded bands show within-level well/event bootstrap mean uncertainty, not external calibration accuracy.
Original 75%, 90% and 100% references remain in all fits. Residual structure is not removed by relabeling, gate tuning or deleting inconvenient levels.

Curves are model-specific inverses; black segments are nonunique isotonic plateaus. Shading adds internally observed discrepancy to bootstrap mean bands. It is an exploratory compatibility set, not a validated 95% RES interval. Values beyond fitted response range are not clipped.

Team-corrected 75%/90% labels are used. The former reversal disappears, while 90% and 100% RAS remain close. Lower panels show unchanged original reporter-gated event distributions assigned to corrected AC levels. Improved model agreement does not independently verify retrospective labels.
Each point is one independent well; 12 reporter/B-fraction pairs and 10 defined co-expression pairs. Molecular population is undocumented. Index association is not RNA-editing accuracy or causality.

Leave-one-dose-out predictions keep all reads from each well together. Error bars are model-based OLS t prediction intervals. Response is raw peak-composition index, not RNA editing; staged biological PER is unavailable. Direct RAS does not beat the training-mean baseline.
